summary: Frontend-only UI testing of the redesigned /services page on web_panel. All data-testids specified in the review request work as expected: hero heading, premium search bar, category chips (incl. chip-all + 7 category chips), filtering by chip, 'View all' per-category link, service cards (16 across 7 categories), 'Full-time Maid' premium placeholder (no broken image), Book Now (add-<id>) adds to cart without navigation and shows view-booking-bar, card body click navigates to /service/<id>, live search filtering, services-search-clear, ratecard-search-results with rc-book-<rowId> buttons (18 matches for 'ac'), services-empty + services-clear-filters path, and no horizontal overflow on mobile (390px). Category chips scroll horizontally on mobile (scrollWidth 1292 vs clientWidth 390). Grid shows 2 columns on mobile (confirmed by shared top offsets).
seed_data_creation: None - used existing seeded data (16 services across 7 categories)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Note: service IDs themselves start with 'svc-' (e.g., 'svc-maid-fulltime'), so card testid is 'svc-svc-maid-fulltime' and corresponding add testid is 'add-svc-maid-fulltime'. Be careful when stripping the prefix in test scripts (use substring(4), not .replace('svc-','') which replaces all occurrences).
